title_en: Do not drink red wine, Neda
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, no author known. 'тук'' is a dialect word I read as 'but/instead'.

lines.cyr: Не пиј Недо, леле, рујно вино,
lines.lat: Ne pij Nedo, lele, rujno vino,
lines.en: Do not drink, Neda, alas, red wine,

lines.cyr: ајде од виното, Недо, глава боле.
lines.lat: ajde od vinoto, Nedo, glava bole.
lines.en: come on, from wine, Neda, the head aches.

lines.cyr: Не ме боле, мале, од виното,
lines.lat: Ne me bole, male, od vinoto,
lines.en: It does not ache, mother, from wine,

lines.cyr: ајде, тук' ме боле, мале, од јадове.
lines.lat: ajde, tuk' me bole, male, od jadove.
lines.en: come on, it aches, mother, from sorrows.

lines.cyr: ајде, Стојан беќар, мале, ме сакаше.
lines.lat: ajde, Stojan beḱar, male, me sakaše.
lines.en: come on, Stojan the bachelor, mother, loved me.

lines.cyr: Ме сакаше, мале, не ме зеде,
lines.lat: Me sakaše, male, ne me zede,
lines.en: He loved me, mother, he did not marry me,

lines.cyr: ајде, тук' ја зеде, мале, тенка Стојна.
lines.lat: ajde, tuk' ja zede, male, tenka Stojna.
lines.en: come on, instead he married, mother, slim Stojna.
